plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Vincent Price is credited on 53 distinct recordings across 11 programs from 1944-03-06 through 1979-08-01. Documented roles include performer on 28 recordings, host on 24 recordings, and guest on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Sears Radio Theater (host on 24 recordings; 24 distinct recordings), The Saint (performer on 10 recordings; 10 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings), Suspense (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Workshop (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Escape (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Duffy's Tavern (guest on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and Obsession (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Simon Templar (10 portrayals).
